{{Quote|In accordance with Article 27a of the Imperial Code of Military Conduct, command of this vessel has been lawfully transferred. New orders are being downloaded to your consoles. Priority one: intercept the ''Brentaal Star''.|[[NR-02]]|<ref name="TOR:TBT" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] '''launched an attack''' on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] damaged [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], the ''[[Brentaal Star]]'', with the intention of intercepting and taking prisoner or killing one of the passengers on board the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], a Republic [[General/Legends|general]] known only as [[The General]]. The attack was ordered by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]], and was intended to be carried out by the crew of the [[Gage-class transport|Imperial transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]''. The ''Talon''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Revinal Orzik]], defied the Grand Moff's command and in response, Orzik was executed by a team of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agents dispatched by Kilran himself, eventually getting the crew to participate in the attack.

Upon engaging the ''Brentaal Star'', the ''Black Talon'' was beset by [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire and Republic boarding parties. The Sith agents joined the ship's garrisoned [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] and worked to repel the boarders. After repelling them, the agents took an [[Imperial assault shuttle]] and boarded the ''Brentaal Star'' searching for their objective, The General. Eventually they reached him, executed him and then returned back to the Imperial ship to withdraw before the Republic's reinforcements could arrive.

==Prelude==
In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy war between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had stood for a decade. At one point a genius [[The General|General]] had deserted the Sith Empire for the Republic and so [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] assigned the ship ''[[Black Talon]]'', to intercept the republic [[Brentaal Star|ship]] carrying the General and capture him. However the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Revinal Orzik]], saw it as a suicide mission and disobeyed his commands.

Kilran dispatched his specialized protocol droid, [[NR-02]] to the Black Talon. NR-02 recruited a team of Sith agents, composed of an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence]] [[Cipher Nine|agent]], [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]], [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] and a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to restore control in the ''[[Black Talon]]'' and to proceed with Kilran's orders to capture The General.

The team complied. They fought through Imperial troops attempting to enforce the captain's lockdown order to reach the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. There they encountered Captain Orzik, executed him and gave the command of the ship to his second-in-command, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sylas]]. Sylas immediately complied with Kilran's commands, sending the ship towards the [[Thranta-class corvette|corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' to attack.

==Battle==
When the ''Black Talon'' reached the ''Brentaal Star'', the republic ship sent its [[Escape pod/Legends|pods]] full of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] to sabotage the imperial ship while at the same time, attacking the imperials with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire. The droids, led by the [[GXR-5 Sabotage Droid]] took control of the engine room. Kilran's team defeated the droids, destroying the GXR-5, and returned to the bridge. The Black Talon received a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] transmission by the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Satele Shan]], who warned the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] not to engage or otherwise she would arrive with her own [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] composed of 17 [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to crush the imperials. The imperials ignored her and moved on, eventually boarding the republic ship in an [[Imperial assault shuttle]].

Aboard the Brentaal Star Kilran's team engaged a series of [[republic trooper]]s and proceeded through decks. They fought and defeated [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ghulil]] and his escorts and the [[GXR-7 command droid]] during this engagement, ultimately reaching the General as he attempted to evacuate. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Yadira Ban]] tried to protect the General but was slain.

The team confronted the General, who was seriously wounded as a result of the fighting. The team chose to execute the General and extract his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant to secure his knowledge. They then fled the Brentaal Star before Republic reinforcements could arrive.

While the strike team was aboard the Brentaal Star the Black Talon crew panicked, with several members believing they would be executed upon the team's return. Lieutenant Sylas attempted to restore order, but during the fighting the entire command crew was killed. Their remains were discovered by the strike team when they returned to the vessel.

Grand Moff Kilran congratulated the strike team on their success via hologram. When the debriefing was completed NR-02 piloted the Black Talon onward to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Aftermath==
After the battle, the [[Treaty of Coruscant|treaty]] between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, though weak, stood still for one more year. In [[3642 BBY]], the direct war would eventually break out under the name of [[Galactic War]].
